answer_1.quote: SEA-VL explores methods to gather metadata from the collected images automatically. We originally intended to explore image captioning in both English and the target language of the respective SEA culture...
answer_1.outputs: culturally relevant image captions in multiple languages

answer_4.quote: All human evaluators involved in the evaluations described in Sections 4 and 5 are either originally from or affiliated with Southeast Asia.
answer_4.guideline: Validators determine whether an image meets quality standards, assess its cultural relevance on a 5-point scale, and verify the appropriateness of its caption.
